keyboard.description: Highlights the next item in the menu
Highlights the previous item in the menu
When focus is on trigger, opens or closes the submenu depending on reading direction.
Closes the menu and moves focus to the trigger

setOpen.description: Function to open or close the menu

setTriggerValue.description: Function to set the trigger value

highlightedValue.description: The id of the currently highlighted menuitem

setHighlightedValue.description: Function to set the highlighted menuitem

setParent.description: Function to register a parent menu. This is used for submenus

setChild.description: Function to register a child menu. This is used for submenus

getOptionItemState.description: Returns the state of the option item

getItemState.description: Returns the state of the menu item

addItemListener.description: Setup the custom event listener for item selection event

getTriggerState.description: Returns the state of a specific trigger, including whether it's the currently active one

getPositionerState.description: Returns the state of the positioner

getContentState.description: Returns the state of the content

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the menu. Useful for composition.

defaultHighlightedValue.description:
The initial highlighted value of the menu item when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the menu item.

highlightedValue.description: The controlled highlighted value of the menu item.

onHighlightChange.description: Function called when the highlighted menu item changes.

onSelect.description: Function called when a menu item is selected.

anchorPoint.description: The positioning point for the menu. Can be set by the context menu trigger or the button trigger.

loopFocus.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation.

positioning.description: The options used to dynamically position the menu

closeOnSelect.description: Whether to close the menu when an option is selected

aria-label.description: The accessibility label for the menu

open.description: The controlled open state of the menu

onOpenChange.description: Function called when the menu opens or closes

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the menu when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the menu.

typeahead.description: Whether the pressing printable characters should trigger typeahead navigation

composite.description: Whether the menu is a composed with other composite widgets like a combobox or tabs

navigate.description: Function to navigate to the selected item if it's an anchor element

defaultTriggerValue.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

onTriggerValueChange.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

menubar.description:
Config provided by a parent menubar. When set, this menu acts as a menubar menu:
its trigger becomes a `menuitem` and it coordinates open/close/focus with sibling menus.
Adapters typically populate this from a menubar context. Omit it for submenus.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Trigger.data-side: The side of the trigger that the trigger is positioned on

Positioner.data-nested: Present when the positioner is nested within another {{widget}}
Positioner.data-has-nested: Present when the positioner has nested {{widget}}s

Content.data-side: The side of the trigger that the content is positioned on
